## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: pedestrian rules, turns, red-light penalties, emergency vehicles, funerals and school buses
Knowledge facts: part C holds 42 fact blocks (sec10-F01 onward) from physical pages 37 to 39; part C2 holds 12 confusable blocks (sec10-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A names the issuer, the September 2026 revision line and the written-test requirement; question count, passing standard, format and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- AZ-YIELD-A-COUNT — written-test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-YIELD-A-PASS — passing standard not printed; nothing shown to learners (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-YIELD-A-FORMAT — item format not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-YIELD-A-TIME — time limit not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-YIELD-A-EDITION — issuer current-edition confirmation pending; issuer page was bot-challenged at intake (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-YIELD-D-BUSIMAGE — school-bus roadway images not read (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-YIELD-E-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- AZ-YIELD-ETWO-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: red-light fines, suspension lengths, Traffic Survival School rules and the move-over law are statutory and can be amended (for example sec10-F17, sec10-F18, sec10-F30); the Defensive Driving Program options come with each citation.
Index: exam authority in A; audience in B; knowledge facts with misconceptions, mnemonics, glossary and dynamic-fact lines in C; confusables in C2; accuracy in D; market in E and E2; definition-of-done matrix in G.

corpus_stability.reason: The Arizona Driver License Manual carries one revision line on its contents page (Revised September 2026) and points to Arizona Revised Statutes Title 28 for current law; nothing in the selected pages signals more than one rewrite per year.
